stages.detail: Two isolated clean builds produced byte-identical shipped payloads.
All shipped Mach-O executables use hardened-runtime Developer ID signatures.
Created one exact signed ZIP archive with a manifest-bound payload.
Apple accepted the exact signed ZIP and published matching tickets for every signed executable.
Built a flat package signed by the exact Developer ID Installer identity.
Apple accepted the exact signed installer package.
Stapled and independently validated the package ticket for offline Gatekeeper use.
Gatekeeper accepted the signed package as Notarized Developer ID software.
Generated and validated separate SPDX 2.3 inventories for archive and package.
Generated source- and digest-bound in-toto/SLSA-shaped release provenance.
Generated an exact sorted SHA-256 inventory for every release artifact and unsigned sidecar.
Developer ID CMS signatures cover checksums, release manifest, provenance, and release evidence.
A fresh extraction verified paths, payload bytes, signatures, package ticket, SBOMs, provenance, and checksums.

scope: Production build/sign/notary/CMS/verification stage checks, not unit cases or device/VM outcomes.
